system_prompt:
# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

messages.content:
Hi, I need a little help with an order.

I had a whole “remote work in Seattle, become one with nature” plan going on, so I ordered a few home office things plus some hiking stuff. Now my company has basically said, “surprise, back to the office soon,” which is... great for my blood pressure.

So here’s what I’m trying to do:

- If partial cancellation is possible, I want to cancel/return just the home office items and keep the hiking items.
- I honestly don’t remember exactly which office items they were, just that there were three of them in that order.
- I want to know how much I’d get refunded in total.
- And I want the refund to go back to my original payment method.

If partial cancellation isn’t possible, then forget it, I’ll just keep the order and roll with the chaos. But in that case, please update my default profile address to the Seattle parent-house address that’s already on the order. I’d rather not type the full address out here if you can avoid making me do that.

My name is Noah Patel. I’m currently in New York, zip 10108.  
One annoying detail: I don’t remember the email on the account.
